action_en: Repair contact paths and verify receipt
action_es: Reparar rutas de contacto y verificar recepción
baseline: 6 accepted forms / 3 phone clicks in 24 days; no qualification baseline
acceptance_criteria: All concierge links reach contact; an authorized controlled form test is received once and the event fires once; phone intent remains distinct from connected calls.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Every contact is traceable to receipt and qualification; no fabricated conversion-rate target.
impact_hypothesis: Fixes observed misrouting and establishes meaningful outcomes.

action_en: Repair native-blog and Substack broken links
action_es: Reparar enlaces rotos del blog y Substack
affected_urls: Two native articles; two Substack posts; exact URL evidence in technical/semrush-reconciliation.json
baseline: 6 native link occurrences to 5 dead booking targets; 5 Substack occurrences to 4 retired offers
acceptance_criteria: Replace links with reviewed equivalent current destinations or contact; recheck published anchors; use a 301 redirect only where an exact successor exists.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Zero confirmed broken links in affected articles; preserve legitimate 404 responses for retired offers.
dependencies: Substack publishing access; verified replacement offers
impact_hypothesis: Restores paths from existing editorial traffic.

affected_urls: Cost, Meal Prep, holiday landings, chef profiles and the templates for 423 offers
effort_estimate: 3–5 days for content; template estimate after discovery
baseline: Conflicting grocery rules; initial HTML for 423 offers shows no suggested dates
acceptance_criteria: Approved facts for each offer: pricing unit, groceries, minimums, service area and date status; matching visible HTML/schema; consistent profile/offer dates; no unsupported Boston availability.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Accuracy and a successful inquiry path; compare received inquiries after 28 days.
dependencies: Operations source of truth; server data access
impact_hypothesis: Improves both human evaluation and machine citation accuracy.

action_es: Recuperar la página comercial para búsquedas de Miami
affected_urls: /private-chef-miami; legacy Miami guide redirect; relevant city/service links
baseline: GSC: 0 clicks / 88 impressions for private chef Miami on /private-chef-miami; Semrush desktop position 26 → 74 across ranking URLs
acceptance_criteria: Verify the redirect and canonical; add real Miami chefs, menus and local proof; direct contextual links to the commercial page; maintain tracking for the same queries.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: More relevant Miami query clicks and a stable commercial destination over 4–8 weeks; no guaranteed rank.
dependencies: Verified local offers and approved customer examples
impact_hypothesis: Targets weakened transactional searches with existing market fit.

action_es: Probar respuestas y fragmentos de la guía de precios
acceptance_criteria: Current quote examples and inclusions; clear snippet/title; contextual inquiry and offer links; retain the canonical and page intent.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Compare CTR for the same query/page and useful contacts after 28 days, adjusting for device and position.
dependencies: Approved pricing and contact receipt checks
impact_hypothesis: Existing impressions provide a practical discovery experiment.

action_en: Reduce mobile JavaScript and fix metadata lifecycle
action_es: Reducir JavaScript móvil y corregir metadatos al navegar
affected_urls: Homepage, /meal-prep, shared head and vendor components
baseline: LCP 6.38 s / 9.04 s; TBT > 2.6 s; duplicate rendered canonicals
acceptance_criteria: Remove confirmed obsolete tags; defer eligible vendors; ensure one title, description and canonical after direct loading and client navigation; preserve consent, accessibility and contact events.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Three comparable lab runs per URL; lower median LCP/TBT without lost measurement. A field LCP of ≤ 2.5 s at the 75th percentile is a later target, not a result measured today. Source: https://web.dev/articles/lcp
dependencies: GTM access and tag owners; representative mobile test environment
impact_hypothesis: Removes measured loading friction across major entrances.

action_en: Verify GBP and publish authentic local proof
action_es: Verificar GBP y publicar evidencia local auténtica
baseline: 5.0 rating / 80 reviews; Aventura #1; outside the returned 20 in Miami and Coral Gables at the sampled points
acceptance_criteria: Confirm address eligibility, hours, service areas, categories and booking links; use a neutral process for genuine reviews; add real photos and locally relevant case examples.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Repeat the same 6 Maps observations monthly; measure qualified local contacts and GBP interactions when access is restored.
dependencies: Owner-level GBP access; actual operating details; photo permission
impact_hypothesis: Builds on the existing home market without fictitious locations.

action_en: Make inventory discoverable and keep proven pages current
action_es: Facilitar el descubrimiento del inventario y actualizar páginas con demanda
baseline: Empty filter inventory in server-rendered HTML; offers are available after rendering; the listed service pages already earn clicks
acceptance_criteria: Provide crawlable city/service inventory links and accurate initial HTML; keep thin filter variants noindex; link to specific offers; show truthful dates; refresh outdated content and review health claims.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Compare organic clicks and received inquiries over matched periods; inspect priority URLs; check that HTML and interface facts stay consistent.
dependencies: Trusted offer data; working mobile and contact paths; editorial review
impact_hypothesis: Converts proven demand and gives AI more reliable source material.

action_en: Earn relevant local references and retest AI
action_es: Conseguir referencias locales relevantes y repetir pruebas de IA
affected_urls: Chef bios; Miami partners; fixed AI panel covering six intents
baseline: Authority Score 18 despite a spike in referring domains; variable AI citations
acceptance_criteria: Prepare useful partner/editorial material; conduct outreach only with authorization; repeat the same prompts 3 times per intent using the same request settings. Record the returned model, citations and pricing accuracy; compare matching models where possible. The scraper does not expose a model selector.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Relevant referring domains and referral contacts; repeated citation and accuracy checks for each prompt, rather than a generic AI score.
dependencies: Real relationships and evidence; explicit outreach authorization
impact_hypothesis: Tests whether useful external evidence and clearer source facts improve discovery.

action_es: Ampliar lo que produce demanda cualificada
affected_urls: Validated service/location clusters; gift cards; seasonal opportunities for Q1
baseline: No reliable baseline for qualified leads yet
acceptance_criteria: Keep, revise or stop experiments based on matched periods; confirm service coverage before creating new pages; prepare February/Easter offers; scope a read-only discovery API only after data quality checks pass.
primary_kpi_and_evaluation: Qualified organic, AI and local contacts and response quality; no unsupported revenue forecast.
dependencies: Completed priorities; adequate volume; real inventory; stable data
impact_hypothesis: Allocates effort to demonstrated fit instead of an unbounded content backlog.
